method: Read-only local cached download SHA-256 before/after; bounded streaming ZIP CRC and part SHA-256; namespace-aware Expat census. No download replay, product/native presentation runtime, rendering or playback. Single elapsed sample includes hashes and parsing; cache state uncontrolled.
indicator_limitations: Element/attribute counts cover all XML parts and MCE branches. Unicode blocks are coarse content indicators, not shaping/language coverage. Comment/signature/Strict absence is not a general detection guarantee.
